text: The two most recent commits (4–6h ago) were "clean-break" clarifications: 0069 added the explicit builder construction sketch; 0071 sharpened that draft *construction* is fine — the bug is unmanaged signing/publishing — and 0027 was updated so "registering an action means implementing one trait" (framework owns dispatch). [...] - **High:** don't wrap `nmp-ffi`/parse JSON — **move the FFI-free dispatch core into `nmp-native-runtime`** and wrap that. [...] **Codex verdict on #2389:** shape **approved** ("the right UniFFI pattern"), with refinements all folded into the posted spec — in-workspace `crates/nmp-uniffi`, `{correlation_id, error, code}` typed result, explicit idempotent `shutdown()`, move the dispatch core out of `nmp-ffi` into `nmp-native-runtime`, `pull_page` deferred to C7, base-object scoping with pre-start seams documented for C2/C5/C6, checked-in bindings + drift gate. [...] - **Blocking:** `DispatchOutcome` must carry `{correlation_id, error, code}` — coded rejections are load-bearing in tests, my 2-case enum dropped `code`.
